rig.description: The sender's rig now, when it changed since HELLO.

game.description: The sender's fingerprint now, when its table changed since HELLO.

tableName.description: Human name of the table or ROM set.

tableHash.description: SHA-256 of the ORIGINAL .vpx (never the patched copy), or of the arcade ROM zip.

romName.description: PinMAME ROM set name (e.g. mm_109c) or arcade ROM name; null for originals.

romHash.description: SHA-256 of the ROM zip; null for originals.

physicsHash.description: Hash of the physics-relevant table settings; null when not computed.

recipeVersion.description: Castcade patch recipe version applied to this table (ADR 0004); null for arcade.

sidecarHash.description: SHA-256 of the generated sidecar .vbs; proves both players run the same patch.

emulatorVersion.description: VPX or RetroArch core version string.

description: client -> host in the lobby: replaces the sender's HELLO `participant.rig` and `game`; the host compares the fingerprint again and re-sends HELLO_ACK to every client. After MATCH_READY (A6.1, 2026-11-01) only `rig` counts: the roster in the log stays final, and the host passes the update on to every other participant (`from` preserved) and sends its own the same way, so each Match tab and panel shows the rig each player has now. Never logged.
